name: US veteran translating logistics leadership into civilian programs

context.occupation: Military program/logistics leader seeking civilian project or program management
context.seniority: Experienced leader; civilian level to be assessed from duties
constraints: Wants concrete jobs rather than generic transition advice
Needs employer title and experience wording interpreted
Does not assume clearance, degree or certifications
Interested in several target employers and broader options
context.company_awareness: Some known employers; not limited to defense contractors

trigger: The candidate begins translating past planning, resource and logistics leadership into civilian searches and discovers that similarly named roles expect very different domain experience.

searches_run.query: military veteran logistics program manager civilian jobs
searches_run.observation: Retrieval leaned toward defense contractors and federal logistics roles. This shows the wording's effect on the sample, not that these are the only suitable civilian employers.

searches_run.query: military logistics leadership equivalent experience program manager careers veterans
searches_run.observation: Employer listings and official title-translation resources appeared. The inspected Anduril role explicitly accepts relevant military program experience and equivalent education experience, alongside specific acquisition expertise and clearance requirements.

sources.title: Logistics Program Manager — Anduril Industries
sources.supports: Direct ATS page describes program/logistics duties, military/government program experience, possible education substitution and a stated clearance requirement. It is not proof this persona qualifies or holds a clearance.

sources.title: Logistics Program Manager — Amentum
sources.supports: Retrieved employer snippet describes logistics/supply-chain experience and leadership years, illustrating requirements-based comparison rather than military rank matching.

sources.title: Employment Fundamentals of Career Transition — US Department of Labor
sources.supports: Retrieved official guide cautions against assuming exact civilian title equivalence. Used to support careful title exploration, not as a credential or hiring assessment.

best_entry_page.primary_query: military logistics experience civilian program manager jobs
best_entry_page.promise: Explore civilian role titles through real employer duties and experience requirements, then follow relevant openings at selected companies.
best_entry_page.cta: Compare program, project and logistics roles and save searches for the titles that fit your experience.
proof_needed: Include employers beyond defense so military keywords do not constrain discovery.
Show duty-level examples instead of rank-to-title equivalence.
Distinguish military experience mentioned in qualifications from veteran-status boilerplate.
Keep clearance and certifications as stated requirements without judging personal eligibility.
Create an indexable guide anchored in jobs, not a generic advice funnel.

conversion_objections: Will every result be a defense job?
Does military experience genuinely satisfy a requirement or only appear in equal-opportunity text?
Are you assuming a rank maps to senior manager?
Can I compare project, program and operations roles?
Do target employers have relevant openings now?

avoid_targeting.query: military rank civilian job title exact equivalent
avoid_targeting.reason: Exact equivalence cannot be established from rank alone.
Eligibility determination is outside product capability.

message_to_founder: Simulation: I have led complex work, but civilian titles do not tell me whether an employer wants that experience. Show me openings where the responsibilities line up, including companies outside defense, and let me follow the ones worth pursuing.
confidence_and_limits: Synthetic veteran persona. Two queries and one direct employer inspection; no assumptions about rank, combat service, disability, gender, education, clearance or certifications. Broad civilian opportunities were not comprehensively researched; retrieval was shaped by military keywords.

search_journey.fit_reason: Need qualifications text rather than boilerplate.
